ghcr.io/acme/tool-call-logger
Observer example: appends one line per tool call and per session start to a log file outside the repository. Cannot block, alter, or delay anything — the observer tier's response is discarded by design. Writes only to $GRIM_EXAMPLE_LOG (default: a file under $TMPDIR).

# The reference `observer` example. Read `catalog/hooks/README.md` first — # it carries the end-to-end walkthrough, including how to disarm again. # # Two entries, one payload tree: a pre/post-style pair sharing one script is # the common case the `[[hooks]]` array-of-tables exists for. Both are # `observer`, the tier whose response cannot change what happens. schema = 1 name = "tool-call-logger" description = "Observer example: appends one line per tool call and per session start to a log file outside the repository. Cannot block, alter, or delay anything — the observer tier's response is discarded by design. Writes only to $GRIM_EXAMPLE_LOG (default: a file under $TMPDIR)."[[hooks]] id = "log-tool-call" event = "PreToolUse" tier = "observer" # `*` is one of the three matcher forms that translate losslessly to every # v1 client. An exact tool name (`Bash`) and an alternation (`Bash|Write`) # are the other two. matcher = "*" # The interpreter form, not `./log.sh`: a payload delivered through an OCI # registry arrives without an exec bit, so a handler whose first token is a # payload-relative file is refused at `grim build`. argv = ["sh","log.sh"] timeout = 5 payload = "stdin"[[hooks]] id = "log-session-start" event = "SessionStart" tier = "observer" # No `matcher`: SessionStart carries no tool to match on. argv = ["sh","log.sh"] timeout = 5 payload = "stdin"
